event_detail: Toaster: the empty gripper hovers over the top of the toaster, above the right slot next to the bread, for the whole 4.8 s without pressing a lever or grasping the bread.
evidence: Zooming on the toaster front, both levers sit at the top of their slots (up) in all four frames, and the bread sticks up out of the left slot at the same height throughout. The gripper stays above the toaster's right half; the wrist camera only sees the toaster's top grill and holds nothing. The plate stays empty. From these frames I cannot tell whether the lever was pushed earlier and has already popped up (that would make stage 1 done); with the lever up and no sign of toasting I mark stage 1 as not done.
